suslicke.title: suslicke.com

suslicke.solution: We designed and built the site on Next.js with a dark premium aesthetic, optimizing images and fonts.

animeenigma.task: Launch an interactive game with fast loading and strong retention.
animeenigma.solution: We built the game engine, optimized database queries and crafted a smooth mobile UX.
animeenigma.result: Stable performance under load and growing player engagement.

xaid.summary: An AI platform that automates routine tasks via LLM integration.

python-guide.summary: An educational Python portal with a large body of structured content.

cost.question: How much does it cost to build a site or app?
cost.answer: The price depends on the task and scope. After a short brief we lock the price and timeline before we start — no hidden add-ons. Landing pages cost less, complex web apps more.

time.question: How long does development take?
time.answer: A landing page — from a few days to a couple of weeks. A web app or SaaS — from several weeks. We give exact timelines after analyzing the task and lock them in our agreement.

support.question: What happens after launch?
support.answer: We don't disappear: we help with support, updates and growing the product. We can take the site on for maintenance or hand over everything you need to run it yourself.

tech.question: What technologies do you work with?
tech.answer: A modern stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and AI/LLM integrations. We pick technology to fit the task, not the other way around — so the product is fast and scalable.

rights.question: Who owns the rights to the code and design?
rights.answer: Everything we build for your project belongs to you. On completion you get full access to the code and assets with no lock-in to us.

remote.question: Do you work remotely?
remote.answer: Yes, we work remotely across Kazakhstan and the CIS. We communicate via messengers and online meetings — wherever is convenient for you.
